title: French Bulldog Popularity Hides A 4.5-Year Lifespan
hook: America's number 1 dog has a 4.5-year population life expectancy.
closing: Popularity should never replace a hard look at a breed's health.
question: What matters when choosing a dog?

segments.say: The French Bulldog ranks number 1. Popularity put it ahead of every breed shown.
French Bulldog registrations rose 1,000%. Demand exploded instead of simply edging upward.
French Bulldog life expectancy was 4.5 years. That population estimate exposes the health cost popularity can hide.
